items.problem: Linked shared project files were omitted from bootstrap.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 only recursively copied -Source and ignored explicit csproj Include+Link items.
items.change: Resolve explicit Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content/Resource/EmbeddedResource items, materialize them at safe Link paths, and feed them through existing rewrite/triage/mapping.
items.expected_effect: Shared shell, styles, scenario XAML, helpers, and assets are copied verbatim and triaged without manual reconstruction.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-running bootstrap on PenHaptics copies MainPage.xaml, Styles\Styles.xaml, all five scenario XAML files, and linked assets; both inking XAML and code-behind receive defer rows.

items.problem: Missing merged ResourceDictionary files were only visible as an opaque startup crash.
items.evidence: migration-score.json score=0 and candidate launch failed; lessons.json errors_encountered final item; skill-defects.json items[1]
items.root_cause: Validator did not resolve ResourceDictionary Source URIs against target files.
items.change: Add a pre-build validator gate for local, rooted, relative, and ms-appx merged-dictionary URIs, skipping external component dictionaries.
items.expected_effect: Path mismatches fail with an exact XAML file, line, URI, and expected path instead of consuming launch-debug iterations.
items.falsifiable_check: A target with App.xaml Source=/Styles/Styles.xaml and only root Styles.xaml fails the ResourceDictionary gate before smoke launch; a correctly linked Styles\Styles.xaml passes.

items.problem: Launch helper missed default dotnet build output.
items.root_cause: Layout discovery only searched architecture-segmented Debug directories.
items.change: Search bin/<arch>/Debug, bin/<rid>/Debug, and bin/Debug recursively for the newest executable+manifest layout.
items.expected_effect: The standard smoke helper remains usable after either winapp build or native dotnet build.
items.falsifiable_check: Given a valid layout under bin\Debug\<tfm>\win-x64, Test-AppLaunch resolves that layout rather than returning 'build output not found'.
